review.scope: Review exact implementation only: deterministic private Drive P001/047 intake and preparation of one additional bounded P001 readiness task after the prior campaign turn is fully consumed. Check task/source/request binding, refusal/recovery of existing jobs and stages, preservation of ledger/old turns and diagnostic drop-in on rollback, no patient/writer/reset/activation authority, no case identifiers exported, no acceptance inferred from correspondence. Actual P001 intake passed; 047 first refused because two historical summary paths exist, corrected to exact prior-bound probes/047/results_v2/summary.json, then passed. This is not scientific evaluation or launch authority.
findings: Task/source/request binding verified: bounded task trigger job and new turn root derive from sha256({source, mode, request}); mismatched trigger_job refuses with BOUND_TASK_IDENTITY_REQUIRED (test-covered); planned() requires exact prior allowance (max_model_turns 3 unbounded / 1 bounded), SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE mode, SUPERVISED model mode, writer_config None, matching source pin.

Refusal/no-retry of existing work verified: distinct named refusals for existing preparation (matching campaign_preparation, evidence dir, new turn root), existing trigger job in jobs.sqlite, active handover units, incomplete turn stages, and incomplete coordinator tasks/bookkeeping; prior turn full consumption enforced (turn count equals old max_model_turns, continuation/review/disposition all COMPLETE) under an exclusive non-blocking flock.

Rollback preservation verified: restore_configuration overwrites only bytes it owns (original or own replacement) and holds with CONCURRENT_CONFIGURATION_RECOVERY_HELD on third-party edits; pre-existing exact diagnostic drop-in is reused and preserved on rollback while only a self-created drop-in is removed after content recheck; evidence/intent.json/failure.json preserved; admission ledger byte-compared before, during, and after restart with rollback on change; old turn root and ledger_repo carried unchanged.

No authority escalation verified: nothing dispatched (pairs {job: None}, models_started 0, jobs_submitted 0, timer_started False, writer_credentials False); require_active_broker refuses preparing against a stopped broker so the script never activates previously stopped units; recovery only restarts units it stopped itself; root check and umask 0o077 on both entry paths of the prepare script.

Privacy verified: p001() exports only the header schema dict, dropping the private case token key and member sha256 (test asserts neither appears in serialized output); 047 output carries only commit pins, contract, and hashes; notebook streams and receipts retained privately at 0o600 under 0o700 directories; no case identifiers in printed results.

No acceptance from correspondence verified: both intake receipts hard-code scientific_acceptance False, launch_authorized/experiment_executed False, exit_status None with explicit limitation text; completed_pipeline requires status REVIEWED_PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED so a passing pipeline review never becomes adoption; execution_proposal in a packet is refused outright.

047 exactness verified: hard-coded prior-bound pins 940293b6/c8124212/dc586665 and the single summary path probes/047/results_v2/summary.json; summaries byte-compared across both historical commits and against the prior receipt's notebook/summary hashes; exactly one matching stream required and byte-compared to the collected original; duplicate identical streams refuse fail-closed (ORIGINAL_SIBLING_NOTEBOOK_STREAM_DIFFERS), consistent with the corrected rerun described in scope.

Suggestion (non-blocking): drive_science_intake.main() sets no restrictive umask, so the output receipt briefly exists with umask-dependent permissions before chmod 0o600; contents contain no case identifiers, but setting umask 0o077 as the prepare script does would close the window.

Suggestion (non-blocking): opening branch.lock with mode 'a' can create the lock file in the preserved old turn root even when subsequent checks refuse; benign operational artifact, but consider creating it only after the existence checks or documenting it.

Suggestion (non-blocking): omitting --git-dir in 047 mode fails only via the downstream git subprocess error rather than an argparse-level requirement; fail-closed but a clearer named refusal would help operators.

disposition: Concur within exact implementation scope. Scientific acceptance and reserved authority remain separate.
optional_suggestions: Deferred; intake invoked beneath existing private 0700 parent. No additional infrastructure expansion.
